texts.zh: 我们的一些情报机构发现了一些资料，这些资料指出[ringworld_builder.GetName]的环形世界可能是一个大规模杀伤武器的秘密发射平台。虽然这些资料的正确性有待确认，但这样的见解已经在国内定型，公众要求我们采取行动。可以确定的是如果[ringworld_builder.GetName]没有什么可隐瞒的话，他们会允许我们的武器专家检查平台的。
texts.en: Some of our intelligence assets have uncovered data suggesting that the [ringworld_builder.GetName]'s ring world could be hiding a secret launch platform for weapons of mass destruction. Though the validity of the source has yet to be confirmed, the notion has taken hold with the public who demand that we take action. Surely if the [ringworld_builder.GetName] has nothing to hide, they will allow a team of our weapons experts to inspect the site.

texts.zh: 自从[ringworld_builder.GetName]开始建造环形世界以来，我们的几位首席工程师一直在后方关注这个项目，对他们的进程记忆深刻。工程师们相信，我们可以通过在建造现场近距离观察进而从他们的建造技术中学到知识，并建议我们向建造国发出请求，派出一支研究团队驻扎在建造现场。
texts.en: Since the [ringworld_builder.GetName] started construction on a ring world, several of our leading engineers have been following the project from afar, and are greatly impressed with their progress. They believe we could learn from studying their craftsmanship closer, and suggest that we ask their permission to station a research team on location.

They believe we could learn from studying their craftsmanship closer, and suggest that we ask their permission to station a research team on location.

texts.zh: 全帝国的先知们都被死亡与毁灭的可怕景象折磨着，这与天空中巨型环状物体的出现有关。将这些事情联系起来后，我们的宗教领袖担心[ringworld_builder.GetName]建造环形世界的野心激怒了众神，并建议我们在一切都来不及前派出一个代表团，将这个项目封为圣迹。
texts.en: Lately prophets across the empire have been plagued by horrific visions of death and destruction, tied to the appearance of a great circular object in the sky. Putting two and two together, our religious leaders are worried that the [ringworld_builder.GetName]'s ambition to build a ring world has angered the gods, and advise us to send a delegation to consecrate the project, before it's too late.

Though the validity of the source has yet to be confirmed, the notion has taken hold with the public who demand that we take action. Surely if the [ringworld_builder.GetName] has nothing to hide, they will allow a team of our weapons experts to inspect the site.

texts.zh:
[From.From.GetName]声称他们掌握了有关于我们在环形世界上建造大规模杀伤性武器的秘密发射平台的秘密情报，要求我们同意对建筑工地进行视察。

我们的军事顾问尚未确认这是无心之过还是恶意诽谤，但无论如何我们都要谨慎对待这一局面。
texts.en:
The [From.From.GetName] claims to have uncovered intel suggesting that we are building a secret launch platform for weapons of mass-destruction on our ring world and requests our permission to inspect the site.

Our military advisers have yet to confirm whether it's an honest mistake or something more sinister. Either way we should handle the situation delicately.

texts.zh: [From.From.GetName]的[From.From.GetEngineerPlural]一直在远程跟进我们的环形世界建设，并对我们取得的进展印象深刻。他们向我们征求许可，在建造现场驻扎一支[From.From.GetEngineerPlural]团队以学习我们的工程。

texts.zh: 为表诚意，[From.GetName]同意我们派出武器专家在他们的环形世界中搜寻潜藏的秘密发射平台。一批精挑细选的最杰出的武器专家已经动身出发，马上就能真相大白了。
texts.en: In good faith, the [From.GetName] has agreed to let a team of our weapons experts search their ring world for a hidden launch platform. A selection of our most qualified specialists are already headed to the site. Soon we will know the truth.

texts.zh: 令我们的科学团体激动的是，我们从[From.GetName]处收到消息，他们很荣幸能在他们在建的环形世界上招待我们的研究团队。我们的首席工程师已组织了我们最优秀的工程师团队迅速前往环形世界，以报告建造进度。
texts.en: To the excitement of the scientific community, we have received word that the [From.GetName] would be honored to host a team of our researchers on their ring world. The engineering chief has organized to send a delegation of our finest engineers there shortly, to report on the construction process.

texts.zh: 令我们的科学团体激动的是，我们从[From.GetName]处收到消息，他们很荣幸能在他们在建的环形世界上招待我们的研究团队。我们的首席工程师已组织了我们最优秀的工程师团队迅速前往环形世界，以报告建造进度。
texts.en: To the excitement of the scientific community, we have received word that the [From.GetName] would be honored to host a team of our researchers on their ring world. The engineering chief has organized to send a delegation of our finest engineers there shortly, to report on the construction process.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]对我们的高规格出访致以热切的问候，承诺停止环形世界的建造工作，直到我们的宗教领袖感到满意，认定环形世界不会违背神的意志为止。

数位精选的神官已经立刻启程前往建造现场，以确保残酷的预言永远不会成真。
texts.en:
The [From.GetName] welcomes our efforts to align with a higher presence, and promises to halt all construction on the ring world till our religious leaders are satisfied that it won't interfere with divine will.

A handful of chosen officials are setting out for the construction site immediately, to ensure that the grim prophecy is never fulfilled.

texts.zh: 不幸的是[From.GetName]并没有同意我们的提议，此举恶化了我们两帝国间的关系。
texts.en: Unfortunately the [From.GetName] did not agree to our terms, worsening the relations between our empires.

texts.zh: 送去检查[From.GetSpeciesName]的环形世界的专家为搜寻秘密发射平台而找遍了整个建造平台，然而没有找到任何能支持我们宣称的东西。我们只能归结为我们情报部门存在缺陷，下次应该更谨慎地检查我们的情报来源。
texts.en: The experts sent to inspect the [From.GetSpeciesName] ring world have scoured the construction site for a secret launch platform, yet found nothing to back our claims. We can only conclude that our intelligence was faulty, and review our sources more carefully the next time.

texts.zh: 我们送去[From.GetSpeciesName]环形世界的研究者带回了工程学领域的新知识。虽然最初双方因文化差异而产生过一些误解，但是双方都对交换知识感到很满意，并从对方处学到了很多。
texts.en: The researchers we sent to the [From.GetSpeciesName] ring world have returned with new knowledge within the field of engineering. Despite some initial misunderstandings due to cultural differences, both teams were satisfied with the exchange and have learned much from each other.

texts.zh: 我们送去[From.GetSpeciesName]环形世界的研究者带回了工程学领域的新知识。虽然最初双方因文化差异而产生过一些误解，但是双方都对交换知识感到很满意，并从对方处学到了很多。
texts.en: The researchers we sent to the [From.GetSpeciesName] ring world have returned with new knowledge within the field of engineering. Despite some initial misunderstandings due to cultural differences, both teams were satisfied with the exchange and have learned much from each other.

texts.zh: 我们送去为[From.GetName]的环形世界封圣的神官已从他们的任务返回，带回的疑问比答案更多。他们在建造平台上冥想后，进入了深层出神状态，发现环形世界根本不是那些可怕景象的源泉。虽然不能破解景象的真正意义，但他们还是安抚我们说：“可能发生的事情，同样可能永远不会发生……”
texts.en: The religious officials sent to consecrate the [From.GetName]'s ring world, have returned from their mission with more questions than answers. As they meditated on the construction platform, they entered a deep divinatory trance, and discovered that the ring world is not the cause of the visions after all. Though unable to decipher the true meaning of the visions, they reassure us that "what may be, may never be..."

texts.zh: 在几乎把建造平台翻了个底朝天之后，来自[From.From.GetName]的武器专家终于而且只能承认我们的环形世界根本没有所谓的秘密武器发射平台。我们已经给够支持了，只要他们愿意相信……
texts.en: After picking half the construction site apart, the weapons experts from the [From.From.GetName] finally had to concede that there is no secret weapons launch platform on our ring world. An effort we could have spared them, if only they had trusted us...

texts.zh: 在环形世界待过几周后，来自[From.From.GetName]的工程师现已离开。虽然有文化上的差异，不过双方对交换知识感到很满意，并从对方处学到了很多。
texts.en: After spending several weeks on the ring world, the engineers from [From.From.GetName] have now left. Despite their cultural differences, both teams were satisfied with the exchange and have learned much from each other.

texts.zh: 在环形世界待过几周后，来自[From.From.GetName]的工程师现已离开。虽然有文化上的差异，不过双方对交换知识感到很满意，并从对方处学到了很多。
texts.en: After spending several weeks on the ring world, the engineers from [From.From.GetName] have now left. Despite their cultural differences, both teams were satisfied with the exchange and have learned much from each other.

texts.zh:
当他们在建造平台上冥想时，来自[From.From.GetName]的宗教领袖宣称他们进入了深层出神状态，期间他们发现环形世界根本不是不详景象的起因，虽然不愿意对景象的真正意义作最终解释，但他们留下了安抚人心的话：“可行之事，亦可不行……”

谢天谢地，建造工作终于能继续进行了。
texts.en:
As they were meditating on the ring world construction platform, the religious leaders from the [From.From.GetName] claim they entered a deep divinatory trance, during which they discovered that the ring world is not the cause of the ominous visions after all. Though unwilling to give a final answer on the true meaning of the visions, they left us with the comforting notion that "what may be, may never be..."

Thankfully construction can now begin again.

texts.zh: 在几乎把建造平台翻了个底朝天之后，来自[From.From.GetName]的武器专家终于而且只能承认我们的环形世界根本没有所谓的秘密武器发射平台。我们已经给够支持了，只要他们愿意相信……
texts.en: After picking half the construction site apart, the weapons experts from the [From.From.GetName] finally had to concede that there is no secret weapons launch platform on our ring world. An effort we could have spared them, if only they had trusted us...

texts.zh: 在环形世界待过几周后，来自[From.From.GetName]的工程师现已离开。虽然有文化上的差异，不过双方对交换知识感到很满意，并从对方处学到了很多。
texts.en: After spending several weeks on the ring world, the engineers from [From.From.GetName] have now left. Despite their cultural differences, both teams were satisfied with the exchange and have learned much from each other.
